author: Megaprojects
description:
Germany shut down its last three nuclear reactors in April 2023, amid an energy crisis and warnings of blackouts. The lights stayed on. Coal generation fell, prices dropped, and renewables grew. But Germany now imports electricity, faces decades of radioactive waste cleanup, and the debate over this decision rages on.
